shared_or_similar_visual_information: A collection of selected square grid cells filled in gray. On the left, use the selected gray unit cells of the four-by-four grid. On the right, use the chain of six gray unit cells in the rectangular grid.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The cells marked gray specify a finite collection of occupied squares of the candidate shape. Right image: The six marked unit squares make up the figure available for cutting and rearrangement.
Rationales: The marked cells belong to the discrete figure under consideration. Unfilled grid cells remain outside that figure for the geometry operation specified in each problem.
